policies.title: Clipper Card Refund Policy
policies.content: Clipper Card cash value can be refunded by submitting a request at clippercard.com or calling (877) 878-8883. A $5.00 processing fee is deducted from the refund. Allow 4-6 weeks for processing. Cards must have been inactive for at least 60 days before a refund is issued.
synonyms: money back on my Clipper Card
get a refund on my card

policies.title: Excursion Ticket Refund Policy
policies.content: Single-ride paper tickets purchased from station vending machines are non-refundable. High-value tickets (HVT) with remaining value may be exchanged at the BART Customer Service Center, 2150 Webster Street, Suite 300, Oakland, CA 94612, within 90 days of purchase. Transbay and SFO Airport surcharges are non-refundable once the trip is completed.

policies.title: Lost and Found Reporting
policies.content: Report lost items by calling BART Lost & Found at (510) 464-7090 Monday through Friday, 8:00 AM to 5:00 PM. Items are held at the Lake Merritt Lost & Found office for 30 days. A valid photo ID and description of the item are required for retrieval. High-value items (electronics, wallets) are catalogued separately.
synonyms: I left something on the train

policies.title: Lost Clipper Card Replacement
policies.content: Report a lost or stolen Clipper Card immediately at clippercard.com or by calling (877) 878-8883 to freeze the balance. Registered Clipper Cards can have their remaining balance transferred to a new card within 5 business days. A $3.00 replacement card fee applies. Unregistered cards cannot be recovered.
synonyms: can I get a new Clipper Card

policies.title: Elevator and Station Accessibility
policies.content: All BART stations are ADA accessible with elevators, tactile path tiles, and level boarding. Real-time elevator status is available at bart.gov/elevators and via the BART app. If an elevator is out of service, BART provides free accessible shuttle service between stations. Call (510) 464-6000 for real-time assistance.

policies.title: Clipper Discount Fare Eligibility
policies.content: Seniors aged 65 and older, persons with disabilities, and Medicare cardholders qualify for the Clipper Discount fare at 62.5% off the standard fare. Apply at a Clipper Customer Service Center with a valid photo ID and proof of eligibility. RTC (Regional Transit Connection) disability cards from MTC are also accepted.

policies.title: Distance-Based Fare Structure
policies.content: BART fares are calculated based on distance traveled, starting at $2.15 for trips up to 6 miles and reaching $10.30 for trips over 40 miles. A $1.40 Transbay surcharge applies when crossing the Bay between San Francisco and East Bay stations. An additional $4.95 surcharge applies for trips to or from SFO Airport, and $6.70 for Oakland Airport.

policies.title: Children's Fare Policy
policies.content: Children under 5 ride free on BART when accompanied by a paying adult, with a maximum of 2 free children per paying adult. Children aged 5-12 pay a reduced fare of 50% of the adult distance-based fare using a youth Clipper Card. All surcharges (Transbay, SFO, Oakland Airport) apply at full rate regardless of age.
synonyms: how much for children on BART

policies.title: Emergency Procedures
policies.content: In an emergency, use the white emergency intercom on each BART car to contact the train operator, or press the red emergency call button on station platforms. BART Police can be reached 24/7 at (510) 464-7000. Text tips can be sent anonymously to 472727 (GBPD). Do not exit trains between stations unless directed by BART personnel.
synonyms: how do I call for help on BART

policies.title: Food, Drink, and Conduct Policy
policies.content: Eating, drinking, and smoking are prohibited on BART trains and in paid areas of stations. Fines start at $250 for violations. Bikes are allowed on BART at all times except peak commute hours (weekdays 7:00-9:00 AM and 4:30-6:30 PM) in the first three cars. Quiet cars are designated in the first and last car of each train.

policies.title: Operating Hours
policies.content: BART operates Monday through Friday from 5:00 AM to midnight, Saturday from 6:00 AM to midnight, and Sunday from 8:00 AM to 9:00 PM. Service frequency is every 15 minutes during peak hours and every 20 minutes during off-peak. Holiday and special event schedules are posted at bart.gov/schedules.
synonyms: when is the last BART train

policies.title: Customer Service and Feedback
policies.content: Contact BART Customer Service at (510) 464-6000 Monday through Friday, 6:00 AM to 7:00 PM. Feedback may also be submitted online at bart.gov/contact. Service alerts and real-time departure information are available via the BART app and @SFBARTalert on X. Written complaints receive a response within 21 business days.
synonyms: I want to make a complaint
